g.text: The chain of systems that proves what changed and who knew: the pipeline writing deployments into service management, service management and work tracking
writing evidence into the risk register, the people system driving workforce identity, and monitoring paging one on-call for outages and intrusions alike. Every edge
is a system writing to a system; the day a person retypes a change number, the chain is a story.
